feature: A component copy follows its look once it is drawn, and a second question can be removed
summary: A copy set to a Variant and Size pair nobody drew now switches to the real drawing as soon as somebody draws it, with no click. A second question like Size can be taken away again with the minus on its row, and copies drop back to the drawing that matches their remaining answers.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/variant-follows-and-goes-walk.json.

try.do: Drop a Badge, choose Edit Original, add a second Variant called Secondary, then Add > New Variant Property and type Large over Size 2. Press Done.
Drop another Badge, pick it and click Large. Nobody drew Default Large, so it shows Secondary · Large as a stand-in.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Choose Edit Original, click Default under Variant, choose Add > Another Size and type Large. Press Done.
Look at the copy: its label now reads Badge · Default · Large, and you never clicked it.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Choose Edit Original again and click the minus at the end of the Size row (or right-click the row and choose Remove Size).
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Command Z once: Size and its Large drawings come back. Click the minus again and press Done.
Pick the copy: it shows Default and its panel asks Variant alone.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

evaluate: When you draw the missing pair, is it right that every copy waiting for it switches straight away, before you press Done on the copy's side?
Removing Size deletes the Large drawings and keeps the Default ones. Is that what you expect, or would you rather keep them as extra Variant answers?
Is the minus at the end of the Size row, matching the other property rows, where you would look to take it away?
After removing Size, does it feel right that only questions added beside the first can be removed, and the first stays?
rough: No mock covers taking a question away; the minus copies the panel's own property rows, and a right-click on the row says Remove Size.
Removing a question leaves the remaining drawings where they stood in the grid, a single column on a page still sized for the grid, rather than laying them out afresh.
Removing a question is not in the menu bar, and neither is adding one; both live in the Properties section of Edit Original.
